items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I quit Faith Band in 22 to go to California.

ctx.x: Well off and on, two years. Off and on. But I worked on a boat more often without fate than I did with fate. See the struggles of people, like when I went, I went back to North, which would go to fate. And I quit fate. I stayed all 1918 till 1920. My dear Ory sent for me. Somebody knocked on the door. Let me see. I quit Faith Band in 22 to go to California.

Then I went with Eddie Allen's band. Dr. Howard? Gentlemen, gentlemen. How are you, sir? What are you recruiting, then? Where the hell are you, man? I called y'all. Give me some skin. Where was I? We called her. Well, you know, I have other things to do. Yeah, but I met this chick over to see you, man, and she said, Paul. That's right. They just left. You just missed them by 10 minutes. We haven't had Paul all day long. I haven't missed anything.

items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: one on the boat with you and Johnny, of course, and Fates Band with Lewis Armstrong.

ctx.x: I haven't been asked with that. Huh? That one right there, sat right there? What, this? Yeah. This is an oldie. I'll say it, too. I mean, sit it anywhere. It's not the way you want, man. Ain't nothing but all the time. You're not going to ruin nothing, no? Well, you ain't going to ruin nothing. And if you do? No, I won't do that. you do? No, I won't do that. They say, I'm not sure what's careless. No. He's not talking about me when I'm gone. No, I don't talk about my friends. I talk about them to their face.…

one on the boat with you and Johnny, of course, and Fates Band with Lewis Armstrong. Yeah. And Johnny Dodds on the clarinet. Did he ever play with you all night? No, he just was only that day to pose for that picture. Is that all? I've never heard of Johnny playing on the

band. Yeah, he was a tour that we made in France. That's right. I'm only an ordinary me. That's right. Just only every day. That's right. Can't read much of that. It says in pictures. Yeah, so you just get every phone. If you want anything, come out in the kitchen
